audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart disagrees with the packet and with its own why-text. Content win[] reads Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf; the full layer reads Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf. The whys say Olaf wins 1-2, Garen takes the lane back at 3-5, Olaf spikes at 6, and Garen wins first item and beyond.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Olaf, Olaf, Garen, Garen, Olaf, Garen, Garen] at a 54.78% Garen win rate. That is exactly what the why-text already describes: Olaf's level-1 axe and Reckless Swing DPS beats an unspiked Garen, Garen stabilises on Perseverance from 3, Ragnarok flips 6, and Garen out-scales after items.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Olaf 4/10, Olaf 4/10, Garen 6/10, Garen 6/10, Olaf 4/10, Garen 6/10, Garen 6.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text says Ragnarok makes him 'immune to CC' and that 'he heals off Reckless Swing' / 'heals through Reckless Swing'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Ragnarok is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — the concrete consequence for Garen is that Decisive Strike's silence does nothing while it is up, on a 100/90/80s cooldown. Reckless Swing deals true damage to Olaf as well and only 'refund[s] the Health cost if he destroys the target' — that is a refund on a kill, not sustain during a trade; his in-fight sustain is Berserker Rage life steal, which scales with his missing health.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok = disable immunity (your silence is dead weight); his sustain is missing-health life steal, not a Reckless Swing heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tough It Out (W) is never mentioned, and Reckless Swing's true damage is not tied to itemisation.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions: his W shield (16/15/14/13/12s) absorbs the burst window Garen needs, so it must be forced out before committing; Reckless Swing is true damage, so stacking raw armour does not answer it.
audit.corrected: Force Tough It Out before you commit; do not answer Reckless Swing with armour.

audit.why: Lose the level 1-2 fight, stabilise from 3, concede 6 to Ragnarok, take the lane back on items — early/mid/late prose is accurate once the Ragnarok wording is fixed.

notes: Whole level chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers to match the packet and the existing why-text. NOT changed because it cannot be verified from the kits: whether Ragnarok's disable immunity also removes or ignores a slow such as Decisive Strike's — Riot's text says 'disables', which does not settle slows either way, so those claims were rewritten around the silence interaction (which is certain) rather than asserted. Also unaddressed at champion level: diff is 'EVEN' with diffRating 7.5/10 and carryRating 8.5/10 while Garen wins 54.78% here, and breakdown.difficulty / report[14].t carry a raw 'Overall difficulty' sentence rather than a rating line; those three fields are wired together and cannot be fixed piecemeal inside the length band.
